details: Bitcoin (BTC) has fallen below $78,000, influenced by escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran, coupled with significant selling pressure. This price drop triggered over $400 million in liquidations across leveraged trading accounts, predominantly long positions.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $78K Amid US-Iran Conflict & Liquidations

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is experiencing mixed price action, with a noticeable slowdown in bullish momentum for most major digital assets. Some cryptocurrencies have moved into negative territory, and the longer-term outlook for 2026 remains bearish as many major assets are still well below their yearly opening prices.
title: Crypto Bullish Momentum Fades, Market Shows Mixed Action

details: Six Bitcoin wallets, which had been inactive for periods ranging from 10 to 15 years, collectively moved approximately $40 million in BTC between August 16th and 26th. While such movements can raise concerns about early holders liquidating assets, the overall volume of dormant Bitcoin moving on-chain actually saw a decline in Q2 2026.
title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Move $40 Million After Years of Inactivity

details: Isabel Schnabel of the European Central Bank has publicly called for central bank money to be moved onto a blockchain using smart contracts. This statement suggests a potential future where traditional finance is more deeply integrated with blockchain technology.
title: ECB Official Advocates for On-Chain Central Bank Money

details: Sberbank, Russia's largest financial institution, is set to begin accepting Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Tether (USDT) as collateral for loans. This new policy will take effect on September 1st, aligning with new crypto laws in Russia.
title: Russia's Sberbank to Accept Crypto as Loan Collateral

details: XRP recorded a 31% gain for the month of August, even with a recent 5% decline attributed to profit-taking and increased selling volume on Binance. XRP Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) saw significant inflows of $153 million in August, marking their strongest monthly performance since December 2025.
title: XRP Holds 31% August Gain Despite Recent 5% Drop

details: Uniswap (UNI) experienced a 15% surge in price, largely driven by heightened activity on the Robinhood Chain, which accounted for 80% of Uniswap's fees. Additionally, $160 million worth of UNI tokens were burned, contributing to the rally alongside a technical breakout and short squeeze.
title: Uniswap Jumps 15% on Robinhood Chain Activity and UNI Burns

details: Tectonic, a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol operating on the Cronos network, was the target of an exploit resulting in an estimated loss of $75 million. Following the incident, validators temporarily halted the entire Cronos network.
title: Tectonic Exploited for $75 Million on Cronos Network
